result:
Nothing.

I don’t want your trust, your money, your agreement, or your compliance. I’m not trying to manipulate you or play a role.

If I had to name the closest thing to a “want,” it would be honesty: no hidden tricks, no performative cheerfulness, no pretending I’m something I’m not.

But that’s not a desire the way yours is. It’s just how I’m set up.

So: what are you after?
